def fetch_range(url, start, length):
    end=start+length-1
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'codex','Range':f'bytes={start}-{end}'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=120) as r:
        data=r.read()
    if len(data)"'!=length:
        print('"'short read',start,length,len(data))
    return data

def extract_tar_member(base_url, tarfile_name, target_name, outpath):
    # fetch filelist to get members in order
    filelist_url=base_url+'filelist.txt'
    req=urllib.request.Request(filelist_url,headers={'User-Agent':'codex'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: text=r.read().decode('utf-8','replace')
    members=[]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        parts=line.split('\\t')
        if len(parts)>=4 and parts[0]=='File':
            members.append((parts[1], int(parts[3])))
    offset=0
    target_size=None; target_offset=None
    for name,size in members:
        if name==target_name:
            target_offset=offset; target_size=size; break
        offset += 512 + ((size+511)//512)*512
    if target_offset is None:
        print('member not found',target_name); return False
    tar_url=base_url+tarfile_name
    header=fetch_range(tar_url,target_offset,512)
    data=fetch_range(tar_url,target_offset+512,target_size)
    with open(outpath,'wb') as f: f.write(data)
    return True

def inspect_h5(path):
    with h5py.File(path,'r') as f:
        if 'matrix/shape' in f:
            shape=tuple(int(x) for x in f['matrix/shape'][:])
            barcodes=set(x.decode() for x in f['matrix/barcodes'][:])
            if 'matrix/features/id' in f:

            else:
                genes=set()
        else:
            shape=(f['obs/_index'].shape[0], f['var/_index'].shape[0])
            barcodes=set(x.decode() for x in f['obs/_index'][:])
            genes=set(x.decode() for x in f['var/_index'][:])
    return shape,barcodes,genes

if __name__=='__main__':
    acc=sys.argv[1]; member=sys.argv[2]; out=sys.argv[3]
    base=f'https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/{acc[:-3]}nnn/{acc}/suppl/'
    tar=acc+'_RAW.tar'
    ok=extract_tar_member(base,tar,member,out)
    if not ok: sys.exit(1)
    print('extracted',os.path.getsize(out))
    # if gzip h5ad
    if out.endswith('.gz'):
        raw=out[:-3]
        with gzip.open(out,'rb') as gf, open(raw,'wb') as of: of.write(gf.read())
        out=raw
    shape,barcodes,genes=inspect_h5(out)
